prompt_preview: Today is 2026-10-20. Competition on 2026-12-05 (46 days away, about 6 weeks). Role: leader. Dances to prepare: waltz, chacha. Minutes per day: 20.

args.headline: A repeatable 20-minute week for waltz and cha cha

sessions.focus: Cha cha: steady break steps and a clean turn

items.label: Basic forward half — focus on the break on 2
New Yorker — check forward with the right foot
Full cha cha routine; repeat smoothly, then slightly quicker

sessions.why: Start with your least-accurate practiced figure, then finish with a legal routine that links your basic, New Yorker, and Underarm Turn.

sessions.focus: Waltz: build a comfortable box and smooth timing

items.label: Box Step — forward-side-close, back-side-close
Left Foot Closed Change — travel straight
Full box-step routine; repeat smoothly, then slightly quicker

sessions.why: Waltz has no practice history yet, so begin with its Newcomer foundation and finish by repeating a checked routine.

sessions.focus: Cha cha: make the basic-to-turn connection easy

items.label: Basic forward half — keep the chasse small
New Yorker — keep the right foot ready to start
Full cha cha routine; repeat smoothly, then slightly quicker

sessions.why: Extra attention goes to the lower-accuracy cha cha basic, while the routine gives you a chance to use the familiar New Yorker too.

sessions.focus: Waltz: practice the turn sequence without rushing

items.label: Box Step — keep the feet closing on 3
Left Foot Closed Change — switch to the right foot
Full waltz routine; repeat smoothly, then slightly quicker

sessions.why: This checked chain lets you practice both turns with the needed change step between them.

sessions.focus: Waltz: reinforce the box and closed changes

items.label: Box Step — draw a clear square
Right Foot Closed Change — forward-side-close
Full box-step routine; repeat smoothly, then slightly quicker

sessions.why: A second focused waltz day builds basic movement and gives you a little isolated practice with another Newcomer change step.

sessions.focus: Cha cha: connect the figures while staying on time

items.label: Basic forward half — start the break on 2
Underarm Turn — start with the right foot free
Full cha cha routine; repeat smoothly, then slightly quicker

sessions.why: Keep the basic sharp and practice the turn in a checked sequence, without letting speed replace clear timing.

sessions.focus: Waltz: finish the week with a confident sequence

items.label: Box Step — soft, even rise and fall
Left Foot Closed Change — finish with the right foot free
Full waltz routine; repeat smoothly, then slightly quicker

sessions.why: End the week with a complete legal waltz sequence, building confidence before the next repeat of the plan.

milestones: Weeks 1–2: Establish the waltz box and cha cha basic with clear, unhurried timing.
Weeks 3–4: Connect the checked routines with fewer pauses; keep the foot changes and cha cha break steps clear.
Final 2 weeks: Use the same 20-minute sessions, finishing each routine at a confident, controlled quicker tempo.
